saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord God.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the Lord, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the Lord of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the Lord in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the Lord: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the Lord: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: But thou, O Lord, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the Lord’s flock is carried away captive.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the Lord, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: O Lord, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the Lord, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the Lord, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the Lord, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the Lord, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord’s.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the Lord be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the Lord.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the Lord; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the Lord a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the Lord; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording

saying: I am the good shepherd

saying: I am the good shepherd

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Lamb
text: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

saying: I am the good shepherd

subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

saying: I am the good shepherd

text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the Lord of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

saying: I am the good shepherd

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Shepherd / pastor
text: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Fold, pasture, flock, sheepfold
text: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
text: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording

saying: I am the good shepherd

saying: I am the good shepherd
subgroup: Sheep, ram, wool, and other livestock wording
