subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Yet, Lord, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the Lord hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the Lord, and besought the Lord, and the Lord repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: For I have not sent them, saith the Lord, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the Lord.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the Lord; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the Lord of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the Lord.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the Lord liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Thus saith the Lord, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the Lord, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go and to sojourn.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the Lord their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: At that time, saith the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the Lord of hosts.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the Lord hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Speak, Thus saith the Lord, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

text: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Lord spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the Lord, and died;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

text: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Lord said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the Lord shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording

subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life

text: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the Lord.

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

saying: I am the resurrection, and the life
subgroup: Death, grave, and other death wording
text: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

saying: I am the way, the truth, and the life
