text: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vine and fig tree
text: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision; Raisins / flagons
text: Then said the Lord unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the Lord toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: New wine
text: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image); Israel / the Lord's vineyard
text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal–peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: New wine; Winepress (harvest)
text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law; Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence
text: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Raisins / flagons
text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant; New wine
text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Strong drink
text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision; Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine
text: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine; Strong drink
text: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine; Strong drink
text: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision; Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine
text: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Israel / the Lord's vineyard
text: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Strong drink
text: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of his hands.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant; Winepress (harvest)
text: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Strong drink
text: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Israel / the Lord's vineyard
text: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine
text: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Strong drink
text: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress (harvest); Winepress of wrath
text: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress of wrath
text: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: New wine
text: Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine
text: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Israel / the Lord's vineyard
text: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine
text: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the Lord, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image); Sour grapes proverb
text: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image); Sour grapes proverb
text: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence
text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence
text: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence
text: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: But Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision; Winepress of wrath
text: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vine and fig tree
text: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine
text: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: I will surely consume them, saith the Lord: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress of wrath
text: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: New wine
text: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drunkenness / abuse of wine; New wine
text: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vine and fig tree
text: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: New wine
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the Lord, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: I am the vine
text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: I am the vine
text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: I am the vine
text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vinegar at the crucifixion
text: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vinegar at the crucifixion
text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Cana: water made wine
text: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Cana: water made wine
text: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision; Cana: water made wine
text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant; Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Strong drink
text: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Strong drink
text: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Strong drink
text: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress (harvest)

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Strong drink
text: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Drink offering
text: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the Lord for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence; Strong drink
text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine

subgroup: Nazirite / priest / vowed abstinence

subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)

subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine

subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Israel / the Lord's vineyard
text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant; Winepress of wrath
text: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress of wrath
text: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress of wrath
text: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vinegar (other)
text: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En–gedi.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Raisins / flagons
text: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law; The vine as a plant
text: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal–hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Grapes, vintage, and gleaning (harvest or image)
text: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Winepress (harvest)
text: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Vine and fig tree
text: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: The vine as a plant
text: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision
text: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: New wine
text: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Ordinary wine / feast / provision; Vineyard as land, labor, or law
text: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal–hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For the Lord shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the Lord to anger.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Lord, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer–sheba, all the days of Solomon.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the Lord, and for the porch of the house.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And they left the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

saying: I am the true vine

text: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

text: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

saying: I am the true vine

text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine

subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the Lord have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken and have done it.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

saying: I am the true vine

text: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

saying: I am the true vine

text: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;

subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Then shall ye know that I am the Lord, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

saying: I am the true vine

text: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine

text: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine

saying: I am the true vine

text: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal–peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
text: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

saying: I am the true vine
subgroup: Tree, wood, and other plant wording
